_comment: Fallback emission factors used when the Climatiq API is unconfigured or unreachable. Values are kg CO2e per passenger-km (cars: per vehicle-km, i.e. one occupant), copied unrounded from the UK Government GHG Conversion Factors 2026 (flat format, revised; sheet 'Factors by Category'). The live path asks Climatiq for the SAME rows (BEIS, GB, 2026, see 'climatiq.selector'), so both paths give the same number. Verified 1 October 2026: every Climatiq result matched this table exactly. The bot rounds output to 2 significant figures.
_source: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero (2026) Greenhouse gas reporting: conversion factors 2026 (flat format, revised). London: DESNZ. Available at: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/greenhouse-gas-reporting-conversion-factors-2026

_factor_rows.train: 25_315_3147_11_1 Business travel- land > Rail > National rail
_factor_rows.electric_car: 25_301_3076_4_1 Business travel- land > Cars (by size) > Average car > Battery Electric Vehicle (per vehicle-km)
_factor_rows.car: 25_301_3070_4_1 Business travel- land > Cars (by size) > Average car > Petrol (per vehicle-km, one occupant)
_factor_rows.ferry: 23_318_3190_11_1 Business travel- sea > Ferry > Average (all passenger)
_factor_rows.flight_short: 21_316_3164_11_1 Business travel- air > Flights > Short-haul, to/from UK > Economy class > With RF
_factor_rows.flight_long: 21_316_3170_11_1 Business travel- air > Flights > Long-haul, to/from UK > Economy class > With RF
_factor_rows._note: Both flight rows are economy class with RF. DESNZ: 'All the factors include the distance uplift of 8%', so the bot sends great-circle distance for flights (no extra uplift). The 2024 values were 0.18287 / 0.20011; DESNZ revised aviation factors down from 2025. 'International, to/from non-UK' has no short/long split, so the to/from-UK rows are used to keep the 3,700 km split.

_short_haul_comment: DESNZ and the Climatiq activity IDs below both split short- and long-haul flights at 3,700 km.

intensity_bands_g_per_pkm._comment: Absolute floor, by INTENSITY (g CO2e per passenger-km) so a long train trip is not penalised for being long: green <= 60, amber <= 149, red >= 150. When several modes are compared for the same trip, a relative band is also computed against the lowest-carbon motorised option (see relative_bands) and the WORSE of the two is shown. Reason: with DESNZ 2026 factors flights are 117-126 g/pkm, so the absolute band alone would show them amber.

accommodation_kg_per_night_by_type._comment: Indicative per-room-night footprints by accommodation type, used only for OpenStreetMap results that carry no footprint data. Rough midpoints informed by the Cornell Hotel Sustainability Benchmarking Index; shown to the user as estimates.

climatiq._comment: Checked live on 1 October 2026 (data version 37). Without a source/year filter Climatiq picks factors from other datasets (e.g. a Dutch well-to-wheel ferry factor of 1.42 kg/pkm), so every request is pinned to the DESNZ/BEIS 2026 combustion rows that the local table copies.

relative_bands_ratio_to_best._comment: Trip total divided by the lowest-carbon motorised option for the same trip (walking/cycling excluded).
